blockers.answer: PlannedIssue.depends_on edges define blockers; levels are computed topologically.

readiness.answer: An issue runs only when its dependency levels complete; a level aborts when failures reach level_failure_abort_threshold (0.8).

enforcement.answer: The executor schedules levels sequentially and runs issues in a level in parallel, so a blocked issue is never dispatched.

state_propagation.answer: Issue outcomes (completed, failed, skipped) propagate to dependents; unrecoverable failures escalate to the replanner.

identity_retention.answer: Split and replanned issues keep the build checkpoint but get new issue names.

evidence.finding: Codex runtime runs the Codex CLI with --sandbox workspace-write by default, read-only for review roles, with an explicit bypass option; auth mode chatgpt/api_key/auto.

evidence.title: SWE-AF Go node
evidence.locator: Two binaries, Environment variables, SWE_FENCE, SWE_PRO_ENGINE
evidence.finding: Go port registering swe-planner/swe-fast with identical API; opt-in OS fence via sandbox-exec or bwrap; SWE_PRO_MAX_COST ceiling; vendored swe-pro engine (beta) on macOS and Linux only.

evidence.title: Pro engine (beta)
evidence.finding: Prebuilt swe-pro binaries vendored under go/bin for darwin and linux amd64/arm64; on by default only via af install or AgentField Desktop; classic loop elsewhere; cron triggers and reasoner calls behave identically.

evidence.title: Deployment guide
evidence.locator: Prerequisites, environment variables, runtime selection, resume_build runtime note
evidence.finding: Docker 20.10+ with Compose v2; provider keys incl. CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (Pro/Max credits); resume_build resolves the runtime from supplied config or environment; Railway uses the same Dockerfile.

evidence.title: delegate-issue skill
evidence.locator: When to delegate; preflight; fan-out and merge
evidence.finding: Ships a Claude Code skill that lets a main coding harness delegate scoped issues to implement_issue, poll execution notes and merge the returned branches.

evidence.title: Python project metadata
evidence.finding: Version 0.1.0; depends on agentfield>=0.1.145, claude-agent-sdk 0.1.20 and hax-sdk for the HITL gate; Python 3.12+.

evidence.title: af install manifest
evidence.finding: Requires one LLM provider key; GH_TOKEN optional; the root manifest redirects af install to the Go node.

evidence.title: Security policy
evidence.finding: Early public beta; fixes land on main first; private GitHub vulnerability reporting; acknowledgment within 3 business days, triage within 7.

evidence.title: SWE-AF CI workflow
evidence.finding: Repository CI runs tests and builds the Python and Go images on pushes and pull requests.

evidence.title: AgentField README
evidence.locator: Install nodes, execute API, MCP, observability, telemetry notice
evidence.finding: Control plane exposes POST /api/v1/execute and async execution endpoints, serves MCP at <server>/mcp, installs nodes with af install, and states default-on privacy-minimized telemetry with an opt-out variable.

evidence.title: AgentField environment variables
evidence.locator: API key auth; Anonymous Telemetry; AGENTFIELD_TELEMETRY_ENABLED
evidence.finding: X-API-Key or bearer auth when AGENTFIELD_API_KEY is set (local-host restriction on install and secret endpoints otherwise); AGENTFIELD_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_DELAY for replacement instances; anonymous telemetry on by default with AGENTFIELD_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false opt-out, no prompts, outputs or secrets in payloads.

evidence.title: Cron trigger source
evidence.finding: Control plane ships a cron trigger source alongside github, linear, slack, stripe and generic webhook sources that dispatch to reasoners.

evidence.title: AgentField run detail page
evidence.locator: Run detail with trace, graph, notes, triggers
evidence.finding: Web UI for runs: status, step trace, workflow DAG graph, execution notes, webhooks, retry, restart and replay controls.

evidence.title: Usage ingest handler
evidence.finding: Control plane ingests SDK usage entries with cost_usd and token counts per execution for local accounting and UI usage views.

evidence.title: Cancel execution tree
evidence.finding: Control plane can cancel an execution and its child executions.

evidence.title: AgentField Desktop README
evidence.finding: Electron desktop shows dashboard, agents and live activity, installs bundled swe-planner on first launch and starts agents with af run; Mac-first with DMG and NSIS builds.

evidence.title: AgentField Desktop build config
evidence.finding: electron-builder targets macOS (dmg, zip) and Windows (nsis); no Linux target.

evidence.title: AgentField workflows screenshot
evidence.finding: First-party control plane Workflows screen with sample sec-af, voice-agent and healthcare entries; shows no SWE-AF build.
